document_metadata.title: 2、EXT. FISHING BOAT DECK -- NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: A body presumed dead suddenly moves, convulsing and coughing up seawater, shocking the sailors who thought the man was dead.

entities.name: Sailors discover a body on the deck
entities.description: A group of sailors finds a motionless body lying on the deck and begins reacting to it, speaking in multiple languages, with their bravado masking fear of death.

entities.name: One sailor nudges the body with his foot
entities.description: A sailor physically prods the apparently dead body to examine it more closely, prompting protest from another sailor who urges respect.

entities.name: The man coughs up seawater and begins breathing
entities.description: The body, thought to be dead, suddenly convulses, coughs up seawater, and starts breathing, shocking the sailors who jump back in alarm.

entities.name: deck
entities.description: The physical surface on a ship where the sailors discover the body and where the initial events unfold.

entities.description: A sailor who questions whether others have seen a dead man before and participates in the tense exchange about the body.

entities.name: Sailor #3
entities.description: A sailor who observes that the body was shot and nudges it, prompting conflict among the group.

entities.name: Sailor #4
entities.description: A sailor who objects to the nudging of the body, urging respect for the dead.

entities.name: The Man
entities.description: The individual discovered on the deck, initially believed dead but later reviving and beginning to breathe.
entities.summary: Multiple individuals exhibit signs of recovery, confusion, and existential distress; one revives on deck, another fears memory loss, a third casts into the sea, a man plays chess rapidly, one speaks to his reflection in multiple languages, and another buys a one-way ticket.

document_metadata.title: 4、INT. FISHING BOAT BUNK ROOM -- DAWN -- TIME CUTS
document_metadata.summary: A wounded man, rescued at sea and operated on by Giancarlo, regains consciousness on an Italian fishing boat; he has no memory of who he is.
document_metadata.source_title: 4、INT. FISHING BOAT BUNK ROOM -- DAWN -- TIME CUTS

entities.name: Giancarlo examines bullet wounds on the man's back
entities.description: Giancarlo inspects two bullet wounds on the man's back while he lies on a table in a makeshift operating room, probing and assessing the injuries.

entities.name: Giancarlo removes bullet fragments with a flashlight and tools
entities.description: Using a flashlight held in his teeth, Giancarlo extracts metal fragments from the man's wounds, which fall with a metallic sound into an olive jar.

entities.name: Giancarlo discovers a scar and extracts a plastic tube from the man's hip
entities.description: Noticing a scar on the man's hip, Giancarlo uses an exacto knife and tweezers to remove a small plastic tube, not a bullet, from beneath the skin.

entities.name: The man regains consciousness and reacts violently
entities.description: As the plastic tube is extracted, the man suddenly awakens, slamming his hand onto Giancarlo's, indicating a sudden return to awareness and physical response.

entities.name: Giancarlo speaks to the conscious man in a first-person perspective
entities.description: From a first-person point of view, Giancarlo addresses the man, telling him he has been shot, was in the water, and that he is trying to help him.
